The present application has been preferred under Section 378(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (hereinafter 'Cr.P.C.') seeking grant of leave to appeal against the judgment of acquittal dated
31.07.2007 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandigarh, in a case stemming from Pfa Case
bearing No.165 dated 28.11.1997 filed under Sections 7(i), 2 (ia) (j) read with Section 16(1)(a)(i) and
16(1-A)9(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
2. Mr. B.S. Bhatia, Advocate, enters appearance and files power of attorney on behalf of the

. 
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that in view of the judgment passed
by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in M/s. Celestium Financial vs. A. Gnanasekaran Etc., 2025(3) Rcr
(Criminal) 1 of 2 Crm-A-16-Ma-2008 (O&M) 208, the applicant would have a remedy before the
Court of Sessions.
